policies.title: Retained data has a cleanup task
policies.statement: Every table carrying the retained tag is referenced by a scheduled task that deletes from it, so personal data is not kept longer than the agreed retention period of 2 years. This rule only checks that a cleanup task exists for each tagged table; it does not check the period. The task's where filter must enforce the 2-year limit. An object that cannot be cleaned up by a scheduled task is exempted by the policy owner, not by a tag added to dodge the rule.

warnings.text: tags "retained" is on no table on this branch, so it selects nothing.
